Subject: Vendor master request — Aurora Industries

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this. We're ready to get Aurora added to Redwood's vendor master so AP can route POs and process invoices. To get set up, AP needs: legal entity name, company address, EFT/ACH instructions or remittance email, W-9 (or local tax form), and a primary accounting contact for PO queries.

I've attached our W-9 and a signed beneficial ownership form. Can you confirm the PO routing convention you use (we use numeric POs starting with AUR- on our side) and whether Redwood requires a specific ERP vendor ID to map invoices? Also copying our AP inbox for any follow-ups.

Thanks,

Finance Operations
Aurora Industries

Hi Daniel — appreciate the fast turnaround and the docs. Quick checklist below so we can complete master creation without delay: 

- Legal entity name exactly as it should appear on invoices (please confirm)
- Headquarters / billing address (street, city, state, postal)
- Remit-to (ACH details or remit email)
- Primary AP contact name + phone/email
- Tax form (W-9 received)
- Beneficial ownership form (received)
- Preferred PO routing (default route is: ERP -> AP -> Payment queue). If you want us to accept supplier-initiated PO numbers (AUR- prefix) add mapping notes.

I have attached our vendor onboarding form for Aurora to complete; it contains fields our ERP needs for vendor creation (tax classification, payment terms, 1099 indicator, preferred currency). If you can fill and return the docx we can fast-track it.

Looping in Grace from AP to confirm routing and any ERP-specific mapping: Grace, can you advise if we need an ERP vendor code from Aurora or if we should create one and map their AUR- PO numbers to our vendor id? Also, any additional KYC redlines we should capture?

Next steps: Daniel — return the completed onboarding doc (redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.docx). Grace/Karthik — once returned we'll open the vendor request ticket.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
